title: Blank ACL lines read before stack buffer
description:
Documented supported blank/whitespace-only ACL lines decrement len below zero in trailing-space loop. Exact extracted loader with stub setters/logging and newline-only fixture triggers UBSan index -1 and ASan stack-buffer-underflow on clean temporary Clang build. Local config availability defect, not remote security bypass. Next: Keep len >= 0 in whitespace-loop condition and regress blank, whitespace, comment and normal records under sanitizers.

Imported from .factory/findings/archive/FND-20261023112118-8e5e-server-security-audit-010.json (category: functional, blocking: no).
